key_insight: Topology-guided regional latent dynamics enable full-field transient response prediction while preserving structural organization and learning history-dependent behavior.
engineering_relevance: TPLD supports surrogate prediction of nonlinear structural responses, including crash deformation, on finite element meshes with up to approximately 1.49 million nodes.
method: Encode nodal responses into coupled regional latent states using mesh topology and engineering priors.
Use auxiliary one-step prediction to improve latent dynamical predictability.
Predict load-conditioned trajectories with spatiotemporal Mamba and reconstruct nodal fields with a shared coordinate-conditioned decoder.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on three FEM datasets, TPLD reports displacement-component relative L2 errors of 4.00–8.21% for a stiffened panel and 1.41–12.22% for a vehicle model; BIW position error is 0.620%, a 30.7% reduction versus the best-performing GeoTransolver configuration.
watch_item: Regional representations depend on mesh topology and engineering priors; transfer to unseen geometries or loading regimes is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Topology-Prior-Guided Regional Latent Dynamics for Transient Structural Response Prediction
